New Jersey Purges Noncitizen Voters
New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill confirmed a Motor Vehicle Commission [software error](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLGOmDAQRL_GdEZmWQNXuEhDd2lTIh9eYCXjRbYDp3x9xC9cN9PM6L0_n8un58hp_-1PclzKEiQsm3wnesolMXL58uEtm-SaFzAwaDNq6Be_Vr5pQd8EZ6Gbtqkh140TTrYDsM3hEK2loUf000YmAI4DbR8mdBSmfgRo2L17ZgQ0xhjoWw8fqx0Qse_py_qg0Py9gq_UciocqKwi1yWRK6-llbw30R21XkX1vxTMCubnedrHl4PTXiXRtz85UW5XORXML4eCefXn5XlPb8bBjjChgrkclDPHqDOdcpMejDE6SVq58j9KRd9SKessMRYdzltTzpIVzE124Xr4dTWMCs1-eo7vY1N_avR28D8AAP__yBiJEQ) improperly registered roughly 6,600 noncitizens between 2023 and 2024. The state conceded that [fewer than 400](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL2unDAQRp_GdEZmbH62cJGGbtOmRAYPMCuwkce7JHn6K-u-wS2PRpqj7_x5Tk9HB4XttzvREvPko5_W-DfgzVc8DuLZ-QJrTDlNoKCTqpegJ7dk-uBkXOVtC82wDhXaph_M0DYAbbVb0wzm4WFWq37oZZ297jvUutHt3KvB64ps-ad6MEopBbp28FjazhijNc6t88Ko9-VdxpoCk0deYryueFCmheuYtuqwe84XC_1LwChgvO-7vh3vFLYcQ6YTuV7iKWAsIwSMxShgfL2PAs33Qb4wMf6TKwXPsuuUkiGGhTL9x8Ay4UacMaGXn5hR7u_gE3ouRGETMFbJ-uum0qvrhVHb6ego4ir_tOrHwlcAAAD__294igI) of them actually cast ballots in past elections. Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon promptly opened a federal review, giving Trenton five business days to hand over records as the DOJ presses its suit for the state's unredacted voter file. The White House called it [vindication for](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2upDAQhE9jMiPTmL-AYBOyt-mGqMEN0yPGjdye4e2efsUVXlhSqVTf9-dr_kI-OO6_8UUjq85BwrzJd6RLTzkO1gXDHTZJOc3goLWus1DPuGb-0OyxCGMDVb_1BY1V1_u-qQCa4jEOtcdlw9A6P2xdPwx95RxsrloC9svWFjzee64D75xzUJcIw9q03vu6pqXBYLx7nwEzlRyVA-kqcp5ycOZVS0l7cYyPnE819S8Dk4Hpuq7yQn1w3LNE-sYXR0rlKi8D081hYHq-NfNKBibfNn1T1wamIE-7yKGZko102Sclpb_2wEvfnG2UuHLmfxTtR-5Oop01J8wsUW1gXeVDiYKBqUhjOC--3bWd8W5_IR_3gyL_1PBnhP8BAAD__880kOY) the SAVE America Act -- and a rebuke to years of Democratic insistence that noncitizen voting simply never happens. ★★★
House Passes NDAA, Sports Amendment
The House cleared the fiscal 2027 National Defense Authorization Act in a razor-thin [216-212 vote](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckL_ynSAQhZ8GOxxc8c8tKNLY_dKmdFZYlAyCw-K9SZ4-Yx4h5TnFOd98P77WLwwxpP07nmQC8-qyW33-lejDV44x8IbuCT6XWlZQMEo1SehXtDW8adXYODNAN_u5IdNNs56HDmBoDoOK_Kvzwzhu_ehho65_qbmbcbQKkbommGdPTaCVUgr6FuFlh1Fr3fe0DeiEVvflsFIbEgdHbHO-rhxDDZbbXPYmmqPWi0X_TcAiYPl5c60HPcStzaeAZc9vKumkVAUsNqe9ELOA5cg3k7yQmVgmrCEnjNKRp8Qk8a5HLuHPv16irdIHthjlb8IiQcHUFOOuT3gUjZPQaj8xxOezqf8r8m3gbwAAAP__qy2IOw), sending the Pentagon policy bill to the Senate. Several vulnerable Democrats broke ranks to back an amendment [barring biological males](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckLsO3CAURL_G7rDYC_hRUKRxt2lTWpiH90pgEJe18_mRpeQHUo40mjM6v97b22DE8_hpktdItLnstpB_n_6mkmNE2o17Qsi11Q04jIxPDMRmbMPLb9L0Tit4zWHuvX5Ns5zVC0D1Hy25krsCHxYJ0xKs5WIMIixiUTYIO_eonz0-geSccxCDgcWqUUophN-VcZ3k3-JM8wOehM6TzbmUHLGhpSHXo4_601qhTvzoYO1gve97-Ht_sDl1sP6rd7Be33j6avbomfMp22oasRCxsDsnfxKjkmsjduXm2QMiPA9GmDCaynaMkVhC13xNxGLOqa_alRsfTePUSX4kg_Hh9u1_ZV4a_gQAAP__DkGK5A) from girls' sports at military-run schools -- a striking reversal for members who opposed similar bills just last year. In all, six Democrats supported final passage while seven Republicans, including Thomas Massie and Chip Roy, voted no. With midterms looming, the [votes showed](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2u5CAQhE-DM0ZMg382INjE2dt0Q6sN7XFL2CCa8du5_cpXeFlVUvXp-_u1fCEnPl9_8CDPIkvMcdnyv5O-peSUWFaMd9lybXUBA4M2owa7YGh80eKwi76H57RNHfnnOLmpfwL03e5Hi0TT08EwjRDNChsOvRt6G1eDSFPH_t4zIzhjjAH7QPgV-sE5Zy2tPUblzLtEbPTgUziShJxLyYkbB3nk-uqS31srouxvBbOCOSKnT8CUqD5CPhTM94WC2Yx3tgrmSuW9Jg54io505FCxiQ41i-iCtX104pNEnxFRC16kMTR95Ua67flA0QeKMOn1XcNOrelQ8SRd80fB3FUfyzff5oZROfM6kNON0rWf-r08_A8AAP__LoSOGg) how sharply the transgender-sports fight now cuts against the left. ★★★
Judge Tosses Minnesota Sanctuary Suit
Trump-appointed U.S. District Judge Eric Tostrud [dismissed every claim](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDGupDAQRE8DmZExZjCBg03IZtMNUYMbpkfGbdlm2L39Cun_C_ywpFLV0_vznJ9AnsL-Gw60lPPs2M0b_w145cjeU17A3WHjVNKspHoIOQjVzbAW-uCsoXa2V63ZTI22HYw2fatUX78smkHDaPSmRt0a57ZB4yrNMqJp5TLqmuy9JwelpZRSdQ2oce0fWuuuw6UHV2l5RgcFGwqZHOaVOUb2VGjNDae99vZVSsxV96tSU6Wm67qaL_xm5aNS03e9UlNJ5xEFxMgUCjrxPt2OonCK6BizcPwWHq58UhEHhYCZC4gMYS0npH-CjoP2BIU4iHR6zHWyLl50a3oMlZb7AeTv37r8VObHqv8BAAD__y_piyc) in the Justice Department's lawsuit against Minnesota, Minneapolis, St. Paul and Hennepin County. In a 56-page opinion, Tostrud ruled the challenged [sanctuary policies](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckDFuhDAQRU9jOpAZ7IUtXKSh27Qp0WAbmJWxEWMguX1EjpDyNf_pv6_X8EIKFOdPXL0h5sElN0zpO_qLtxQC8YjuhinteR9AwqOUbQnNgDbT6QeFhTMa6m7qCm_qtlOdrgF0sRhVj_Xo9AhOTug6_6wb3aFtlO6mUU-6IHPvyRaUlFJCUyE8rX4opZrGjxqdUPLYHGZfUWRynm1K25YCZbJcpX0uglly3lg0HwJ6Af11XdWFvFCcc4qZVs-VTauA_j4hoL-NAvr3Ef5AQL9SjJ5TRi4Zo80H7j_lLbHkueRjP-n0pUvv0i4Ygo-zF9AXu3HbRXehRyuUnFekcKuK_N-Op4HfAAAA__80w4ZM) regulate only state and local officials and neither command nor obstruct federal agents. The decision is a setback for the administration's campaign to force blue-state cooperation with ICE, though DOJ is widely expected to appeal. State leaders defended the laws as tools that keep immigrant communities willing to talk to local police, while federal attorneys argued the distinction between "impeding" and "refusing to help" is a dodge that lets a real crisis fester. Expect the fight to land at the Eighth Circuit.

**Your Cutting Board is a Major Health Risk** [Did you know your kitchen cutting board could be poisoning you?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbGOnDAQhp_GdKzM2AZTUCRZbXe5FJFSosEz7FkxGGFzl8ePWFCy9XX-5htbv_z_eulf0Ac_37_jxJ1PqadI_Rj_zPyRlhiCTwPSDmNc89qDhLqUTQmqR5f9O_caC-oMVHa0BXdVY7U1FYAp3jqmGoBVReNonaK2cW2FemjZ0iDHAQvf7e_JBrSUUoK6ILTO1FprpXgwSELLbSHMfPFz8sTJxbgsMfjsXbrE9V6E7i3nJQn1RcBNwC1wYBd-X1ycBNw01ax5cOU4Kltqxaa04KoSjdWD1VWL2gh1czgt6O9z70moq2i-Pg-aq4B6wRWnw72aqnwFI0-xDcetnz--Cai3PPUpbqvjY_mJH-s7Z16n__ZB_9zE5Lcne_LD4xkOz0wBZ-L1mJ3n5lqsHS0ffi-uboSW9wl92H-jyJ-t972DvwEAAP__mlWwGw) Shocking new studies reveal that plastic and wooden boards harbor dangerous bacteria like E. coli and salmonella... even after a good scrub. Those tiny grooves and cracks become breeding grounds for germs, especially after cutting raw meat. But it gets even scarier: plastic boards actually shed invisible microplastics into your food every time you slice and dice. These toxic particles can build up in your body, with unknown long-term effects. Why risk your family's health when the solution is simple? Discover how Tivano keeps your food safe today. Strong intensity among Republicans keeps the number from slipping further.

Turnout and candidate quality in a handful of swing districts look poised to decide House control.

Our campaign to register new voters -- along with turning out all these voters -- are the two most important things we're doing between now and November.
Vote-suppressing state legislatures are gearing up to pass more restrictive laws. Congress is paralyzed and beholden to the president. Beating our voter registration goal -- again -- to register new voters might be our best hope to turn the tide so we can protect and expand our right to vote.
The math is simple: Every $3 can help register a new voter. Can we count on you to chip in $36 and help register 12 new voters, Team? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SAVE America Act would crash voter registration drives [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote. So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead.
The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. That's why Trump keeps calling for its passage.
Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters .
We're kicking our efforts to register voters ahead of the midterms into high gear. The math is simple:
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we could register 10,000 new voters
➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and this work can truly impact 2026's elections
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072326_2&amount=36]
GIVE $36 RIGHT NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=072326_2&amount=36]

There's so much on the line in these midterms , with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights staying in charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to pass sweeping new voting rights laws.

subject: How we fight back against the pink haired activist librarians
body:
We must take back the culture| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpslpzeo69yXgvsMg_hWtvIDfEmVEQBfVBXm6oS8AK-LP5MMPTemalpWQrNUftk85iuPh2x28upTfAz5FXx8zNo3Ji7C9k7ofsIPUHr_5GKy-SAPW-pbMAbOqmpDPgy2GiGS6EUZkXcsmWdVbPXgRlxR55uNd-NLVntRgDuFlFef0nAq9uRzK3lcuOIaxNmbJa0vk3J1zKiWxkf3q98hItlBbbtHqfpomWQwUJynm2iM4Jw-FpqI2C12anW8B9e93Iogl3txfdHcVNVp4JJjN19hl9DzHsYTU6AoAIW9q-wxhgbWv2gs6GE2Bp2swiBb3sqzOlRry7_QVOfYWQHaDxAQoTR_VruBvuHcdDaEnXdBlLpjaXZygrhTCVskEFRjfdy0T4Dp-DdMhIhbg5qCav48o2kiS7rjAEqunhfy-rtEMXR_gn2oj33Kifg8Pk8cjQOTrE0MKJhxKcJHZlJ7P6NA%3D%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpKiIRXDlTrIPQeJSpDQE7i50rbLmiNYg0luNfl_2G48O-OtOCS6-hoX4fHblcJTRsAOnrYnNcKFYg_AIW5RnEYGwZCNbrgBQ4PcQAiYd77VKNLsl9gRhJOxCiJMCo-SHE3ZpYI2J6YZI3dhfECwqiqFsbCR7kllSUJj3l0_K_Io1Ndi01dR-qhKwIkvhtwzJCJJu26MN9DTf7HrCObYbUYoqnoMePuV5wKhfLn5zqoKynfLhcRGoA4KsNFJSvk5A_m5Z4nGjY4K8577xDa2BI34iTegYLhWSJIGmBy7-weSEgzoJiKe2tMW0oXzbkQybDoJmPk7LVT83-ktaK6YsE6FPLmXMfPFQqKnWtICe3PcIQ8IONC6yxVm5fturSKvtAHSioFl6ztV7IDxb2cDUjh4Htjf5JoVSSennDlJyVmI1-18dIqFAmwxytTsaoC1MicSJ8lzehA8NE8qH8I3SJ9Q%3D%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpNfU8p3QmymM2XxR4l59i71znjiuvgIVpRiv-CwoNBrtrq0VR_2tYk43JbgMF_OajL4EoF1lF7OAo7lYfJcsmEMCQAJUFtg_6acjDUqRcRlFrDqZYMGNIda2gS2WbYi0F8Y2fkTdV4fynKGCf_0RaOST9PettSF8NRq1yw58VLIPScikjpXtuWryzB_IZYmTWbHaGw5nbMQybEh47ampxNs5V8POfiC2xEM-7rV8ebWBJH2BhtnmqHOIZLuNNc0osbr-EpgbbM4Fm_VB_T99kpUJwwmh5wMF0_mfCVLIjyzXxMRAPl-HcbZJjA6OB0uDu-bvtB9BqojDzJdmviQfjOGP-X1yPlgs8eWI-_IWrUV8Ty2g-YaJd1OP73E9AEg_-s9b9l9t8S0Iu6b6NBzx2JqgId7rLFchND6GoEoppgDWA_OuobczzzJA8CZWqx5VcXbexJeu31_WfAT4f_e2uoA%3D%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpiZu2gv0KVvpbI36dK1LX9RZN0K5F2wjj2Y5vn1JDUmp2JapCdXzLuxtcJfz7ttcFYXfs6R4T7eYoQwL56SH7M40oMeYIkRwa8zzZWwAKMNoa7klC7ibz5pWoFnQU6Y3qyvKDzsJsHRrQnxW8I4RTO5hO-iLGzULkjBlnyCCgnjSTBN67tlw3pZn_aBzlDgIUpw4uhf5VFQxa3cH5UC2629DTYdVrn_hlG2mJoxtLpet0h1pU_B4mC45bfjKZTE3NWNBwgLdaGL2p2Viw5ZOJiudsxEglDgX_3u0ZalG7BoHoquXHOM5EQMlvMfwivF1z2We_fdmCOFL6fxl8rbi0QroviD1tIY1p_9FulzLat-UwAgAkdhbzZFu3OHy_mnzERKsrLz8Wa1pHzh-k39gc8_OwS5ZOSm0_Qa61W--PMZii9DBNESBbXzriIULTfWqqM6mnKObAm3ez-ol5RCDRMg%3D%3D)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b28641c609d2468fabca614a2a3a25d2&_e=5wg1AZsjDiME9Iq2ZZhrHVNuf6U-E6r2PyR5ts6Vs13l0bn0A9wgLQvS7Qq7EagvYfssZpXAgoQcuIUBozYblxUnQaVUxy0RfKLk7TC58_PHbbheqG5t5W-h9sTBJDevpvl3ZygQQ_II-QB_fpJ6ITG4XoS8GasdK6VOQf9nAwnQ268r1-sHvCs9vjKXmFH5NsIOsO-Dsbkss4gtYb5D5X02wViS0IYAfgjriELfSNMTjc-uOQ-n8F0vZzkRxmXpZMj02BV4n-0WyGLELTqh1soByE-TrWCVUP5P5E0gMl86LO0d48xi09Pye8uByOv3oZejTXd9ziDlN6vKF0SaD-jROmcGiuT10BxBnaKM9pd6HU4_fhQ5qzAeUeRaWEwcV7XMa-Skfq81BaX0mcEjnCko9KK6_A0EOrKM_qdeZs7em1oUoea04_zv1ZC9RWQoFoRcwiQdA0PHNolaUwCjELCv8HSsI8Rv1f3qEfvHm1nq0kgw9nUwRPG7aFMd6OLMeFNnupcI6zW6-QzlU1qU0lyiwuanLMRt-Q1Z03DSBUzlbxsK4bRB3MJ9EYpW7J5VxnccKwYIl3vzYpst2JVota2vUate0MZqftC6_dJSaGs5Zlki6hAKUvdzGNrPr4d-CRXKwq7NX04H32rFgY-HtsZMKT0eEG5VRojzTMCQb2-D0IzUv6xDicTjBYJp61eSzi36wBSOg6fOHj9d2JgCXw%3D%3D)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. clean_body: We must take back the culture| | | | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical. | | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. name: Francesca Hong
subject: Four myths
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
I’m asking you to believe your eyes and ears
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260723-3073)
Peter,
This one’s a long email, but it's important.
We saw a lot of polls yesterday. Today I want to cut through the chatter and recognize what is one of the most pivotal moments in our campaign’s fight for recognition and legitimacy. Let me be clear: **There is no data-driven evidence to back up the claim that I am unelectable. The Marquette Law School poll made that abundantly clear.**
[Please consider a contribution and help us fight this narrative.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=1&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD) We can’t afford to play it safe—not with families across the state struggling to pay their bills.
**Myth #1: I am unelectable.**_The Marquette Law School poll from yesterday has me in a statistical tie with Tom Tiffany._ There’s no shocking evidence that has me down, no damning numbers that show I can’t win. All of that fuss, and my numbers are practically identical to others in the field. It’s just talk. Next time you hear it, ask them to back it up with evidence.
**Myth #1: I am unelectable.**_The Marquette Law School poll from yesterday has me in a statistical tie with Tom Tiffany._ There’s no shocking evidence that has me down, no damning numbers that show I can’t win. All of that fuss, and my numbers are practically identical to others in the field. It’s just talk. Next time you hear it, ask them to back it up with evidence.
**Myth #2: If I am nominated, we will lose the legislature.** There is no evidence to support this conclusion. Wisconsin voters, famously, split their tickets _a lot._ This myth sounds scary, but we know from 2024 that it’s not true. In fact, our massive coalition will _drive_ turnout for down ballot candidates. Showing up for candidates in purple districts—cities and towns—like I have, is how you increase turnout in November! Our movement is winning back voters who have given up on the Democratic party, the system, our democracy.
**Myth #3: Wisconsin is “different” and will not elect a Democratic Socialist.** This blatantly ignores Wisconsin’s progressive heritage, our working-class values, and the real issues this election will be decided upon. I’ve been talking about data centers, the cost of living, the price of gas—long before the Marquette Law School poll showed us that those were the most important issues. The voters are clear, they want a Governor who will deliver on affordability. There have never been more perfect conditions for Wisconsinites to choose the working-class candidate.
**Myth #4: The only electable candidate is a white man.** Current polling seems to indicate that this is the least accurate myth of them all.****
I’m asking you to believe your eyes and ears. So many of you have shown up for me across the state. Look what we’ve already achieved. We’re listening to Wisconsin voters, and it's working.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=2&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)_Check out the crowd at the Vilas/Oneida County Dems Forum earlier this month!_
**[As always, a contribution to our campaign means the world to me—please consider digging deep.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=3&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)** We have the momentum. We’re on top. But we can’t lift our foot off the pedal.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260723.gaEfdW&amount=5&refcode=em20260723-3073&t=6&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)**
With gratitude,
Francesca
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_fh_footer?refcode=em20260723-3073&t=7&refcode2=3073_105371_e53kwD&akid=3073%2E105371%2Ee53kwD)**

Donald Trump is breaking the law again, and I’m suing him again — for the 79th time in fewer than 79 weeks.
Here’s what he’s doing this time:
The federal government provides billions of dollars in grants to states to help us prepare for and respond to catastrophic disasters. Trump is using those critical emergency grants to try to bully state and local governments into adopting his anti-immigrant and anti-democracy agenda.
These grants are administered by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and FEMA — and this isn’t the first time they’ve tried to play this dangerous game.
Twice before, they’ve threatened to withhold emergency preparedness funding unless states agree to support the President’s political agenda, twice before they’ve been challenged, and twice before they’ve lost in court.
I’m co-leading a coalition of 24 attorneys general and two governors to challenge the Trump administration’s unlawful tactics once again, and once again, with the law on our side, I believe we will prevail.
The reality is that Trump has so little support for his mass deportation agenda and his baseless election fraud conspiracy theories that he’s resorted to leveraging critical funding to try to force states into adopting his policies.
It’s basically blackmail, and it’s against the law.
I’ve said it 78 times before, and today I’ll say it again: Donald Trump is not above the law — so I’ll see him in court.
If you’re with me, I’m asking for your support to keep this fight for justice and accountability going. Will you contribute any amount right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

subject: A sham case, a Qatari jet, and a dropped criminal probe
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Last week, a federal judge ruled that Donald Trump's “settled” lawsuit against the IRS — the one that ended with his acting attorney general handing him and his entire family sweeping protections from tax audits — was nothing more than a sham case.
The judge found that the case was brought for an improper purpose: to give judicial legitimacy to a “settlement” that was not based in the law or reality. And that because the IRS falls under the control of the Executive Branch, there was “never a question as to who would prevail.”
Essentially, Trump’s settlement amounted to self-dealing. A backroom arrangement, dressed up as a legal settlement, that could shield Trump from a tax bill exceeding $100 million.
This administration is straight-up corrupt, and over the last few weeks that corruption has been on full display:
Trump’s DOJ shut down a criminal investigation into Abbott Laboratories' contaminated baby formula, despite prosecutors saying they had enough evidence to charge the company. This was after Abbott had donated $500,000 to Trump's inaugural fund.
And now it’s been reported that just before the DOJ dropped its investigation, Trump loaded up on Abbott stock. ( This is exactly why we need a stock trading ban for the White House and Congress! )
And then there's that infamous Qatari jet. Trump officially took his first trip on a plane gifted to him by the Qatari government — a plane that cost American taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars to retrofit for security (at least as far as we know, since the Air Force still hasn't released the final price tag).
Amid all of that, this federal court ruling about the IRS lawsuit shows what’s possible when one branch of government does its job and stands up to this blatantly corrupt administration.
Democrats in the House have been working to do the same, but Republicans have repeatedly refused to join us to do anything about the corruption. So long as they control the House, Trump will keep dealing from both sides of the table — and the American people will keep footing the bill.
I will continue to do every single thing I can to fight back against whatever this administration throws our way. Are you with me? If so, please chip in towards my re-election campaign’s July fundraising goal now to help us fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]

When I moved to Tennessee, I didn't have a clear idea of what was next.
This community gave me room to work and learn, to build a life step by step. That opportunity changed everything for me, and it's the reason I believe so deeply that America should still be a place where people can start with little and still move forward.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7610c529-ab0a-4c75-a1fa-97e5a7dea80a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**That belief is why I 'm worried about where we're headed, so I'm stepping up to change it (and you can [join our mission here.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))**
Opportunities don't vanish overnight. We've watched it be chipped away when healthcare gets harder to access. It has deteriorated time and time again through bills destroying wages and upping costs. The current administration is holding Americans in place, and worse yet this specific seat, held by my opponent Scott Desjarlais, has been completely complicit.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2d8aa00c-4400-48cd-8e91-106beb2cc135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If you believe America should still work for people starting from nothing, help me keep this campaign going. [Chip in $10 HERE to help our mission.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[DONATE HERE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8bd4f464-9b43-4d88-ad3d-6d3305a5082c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Serving on the Nashville Metro Council since 2023 has only reinforced my beliefs. I see every day how policy choices affect whether families can stay afloat and whether seniors can get care. **That 's why I believe in Hometowns over Headlines.**
It's not a slogan. It's a commitment to keeping opportunity real for the next person who arrives here with nothing but a willingness to try. If that future matters to you, support this fight.
### **Why I 'm Running**

# Friday, July 24, 2026

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1933, Keystone Camp in Brevard held the first recognized [Christmas in July](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OhCAYQE-DnQaBESwotrGbbbc0_HzqN0EwgGO8_WbnCnuB917ez3N-GgwY12-zg65LmiNcJUCtkOfL5As9xHKlHLw7Dwu1YlztzCgbWipbJmZvMNyzaLxeABjwBnQvlVBKDrJvNm29sovkvRutpWbkivayd1yNwhvjH7xB_UejkomeUinGDpyTg1QWlOQPqxYiKHisKXevhLFusIQ7vSF3Lu1N0FutRyH8i7CJsOn05q4pduBPwiYb0loIm3aT0cSANpt8EzYxyvin_9G6LWOpuyktxvZ1hrs7tqPJ2h8XhoBlkETQdTcYPr76r0lvzX4DAAD__xLKe-M) celebration. The two-day event, organized at the request of co-founder Fannie Holt, inspired a tradition that later spread nationwide. Two women [smashed three world records](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAUhE8DHZFtjP0oXGyTLttuifzzCC9rbGScoNx-Ra6w5Wik0Xzfz226WYqU7t92RVPnPCU89oi1YpkOWw4KmPYjlxj8c3NYK6W7mwQTqmO6E3IKluJ7km0wM6LAvkXDNUgArTRvFwOOj3zQwcLgg_JjH5jQiGNQ6NSItiVzrjEtJGdMy_GC3mulwSHofnAwN5JhoJrL5ZEp1QXn-M4vLBef1zaapdZtb_qvRlwbcbXbCXBWZyiVfMRGXONzdVge1v92H5jOL3bdKKd9oW3vjrxi6mQYLWoYuZyZwOCAK-G4cjD0DMDZtpiwHRQj7Uo3kt1XS_Hzov5L3cuIvwAAAP__VIKDUw) at the Lumberjack World Championships this week, as we report in _Et Cetera_ , and it got us thinking: what old-school skills are you still holding onto? Can you chop wood, change a tire, fix a leaky faucet without calling somebody? Hit reply and tell us the one skill you're proud you never lost. # Our nation's best governors: "You can win this, Dan. Go for it! Beat Wes Moore for us all."
Dear friend,
Valerie and I just returned yesterday from three days of meetings with our nation's top 30 or so Republican Governors and former governors and their First Ladies and they gave us a lot of encouragement for our State and race. Watch my video update on the meetings, including with the governors of swing states, [here](https://us.list-manage.com/19zPi8mW3wR?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

In my meetings, including with GOP governors of blue states, one theme was common: Wes Moore's policies are some of the worst in the nation, making Maryland unaffordable for so many, and that with sufficient support, "you can win this, Dan."

**But it takes money.**

Right now, we need to pay for our planned:
* [$6000](https://us.list-manage.com/6RHzlKHc_Jy?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) postcard purchase
* [$12,000](https://us.list-manage.com/YNyTbBllgnE?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) next TV ad blitz
* [$500](https://us.list-manage.com/lQSl8CkQcHa?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)/week for social media
* [$7,500](https://us.list-manage.com/1C1qm5jkMJk?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) for more large signs
* [$9,000](https://us.list-manage.com/nHGqKJ_b6XN?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) billboard campaign

**Will you help us pay for these campaign strategies today? Each person can donate a maximum per election cycle of $6000 and a business can donate up to $6000 as well.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/zVkbrBwZQF7?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

The governors want us and Maryland voters to know that although it may appear Maryland is "blue," so were a lot of states that now sit with Republican governors**. It is common sense to give the People's money back to them through tax and fee relief, to empower them to become owners and innovators, to bring accountability to our state budget, and to ensure our kids have a safe and prosperous, well-rounded and educated future. And I believe we must back our law enforcement and the need to remove all dangerous criminals from our streets, not just those over 18 years old as Wes Moore has signed into law (SB 353, enacted/signed May 26, 2026).

So even though Wes Moore and company are raising money for his campaign in order to continue to take away your family's future with MOORE taxes, costs and LESS safety and opportunity, _we can beat him soundly if we raise the funds needed to get our message out_.

This is why every dollar counts - whether you can donate [$5, $10, $50 or $100 ](https://us.list-manage.com/1CI3O_qeIre?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)\- each donation helps us purchase the needed air time or materials to win for all of us.

Thank you and God bless you and our beautiful and great State of Maryland.

For Maryland,
[](https://us.list-manage.com/D03Xe8PuTbC?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
Dan Cox, GOP Nominee for Governor of Maryland

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

## Data Center Withdraws after Abbott Standards
Kansas-based Diode Ventures has [withdrawn its proposal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u4yAQBeCnwR0RHhP_FBTbuLvbbmkNZmzQJeCFSZy8_cr7Crc70pE-HZ0_X8sXhhjS_hsfZPi95SXRWSMxU1kOTB6Ti0RY2P994jfZ50pUF1DQSzVI0IvDED-Lbpyxyk1tQ6YdRj1OatJT4802bb3eNCq6w9i6bkTrdD9Nne1guINugrkwNYBuWwUw3FSrBt3fnaX-bhFHoRW5wLnc2BPTG-sWP_lF5bbmRxONZz6q6H4JmAXM53neviO_rlLAfNkCZjVcuRMw7_kl0drMLCsGJ9f8ODB9pAtOlrB7luxD2uUZ2LuCJ0bpKTkqNSe55mfij3TIKFdKTEUeJR-5YhQwN8W44wwxhtoPQqv9gSH-H8k_u_Zl4F8AAAD__y2bjqg) for a data center near Cedar Creek Lake in Henderson County after failing to meet Gov. Greg Abbott's standards for new data centers. The company [told county officials](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVvQcRgMg4dKFVu6dkTn-ACrDnZthyRvXyWv0Om_fPoN3_d5PpPzbl-_6Mq6PJYw73zPnkvhNEfaN9qtZ6ZUtt8b_bC5XZjzjID9CdQJ5WzJ-ecsK6sN2LGpWDdqkMMIoxyrTcPSMhujDAzcKsVyGfu2a3G8dGR77iqnXxgolE0DiKqGBpTsO2u47wzRICSwdSWkumxc-EF58c9wcKov4Vp5vZUSs2g_BE4CpzUc9XtUr-EQON2iD2SzwGlxnl-NifOrny5YrqNdqqRtvDvvXe6VkLBeyfk3Xv53yaHxLwAA___C1HXV) Wednesday that the site's proximity to the lake's rural residential community "does not meet the higher standard" it believes should guide development. Thousands of residents had signed a petition to "Save Cedar Creek Lake." Abbott's [June directive](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL8GZ4wwwxo7cHCJs730Qquh2zZaBjjo8e78_cnzC5eVVFK9qvrzuX5CiCHtv-FBM_9seU303SIxU10LpAMSRiKofPx9whe5pydqq1Z6kMpKbVaEEF-r6XB2Cqe-o7m3oxknNZmpO2bnNhw9bGisnxR6BaNzMN0BvTV-6LswX2HKatP3Smt7U72yZvhAR8OHAxiFUYSBc73xQUw_0Lb4yifVm8-PLs4Hc2ni_kvoRejl6wxwGUIv1xKhF_dsIVFrkskfKce8v4ReLqjQi7KXvgu9lJpLboTyjZAIDNJTYqqyREhNNl-hFEK55SpTZvkg4pB2uedTgnOZucnGkBAqXuCuzli-Q4yhDVYYtT8gxHdp_r-rz1n_CwAA__94J5Xj) to the Public Utility Commission and ERCOT says data centers must pay their own costs for electric infrastructure, contribute to the grid's capacity rather than just its demand, and use water-efficient technology. "_Data centers that want to do business in Texas must meet a clear standard. This project did not_ ," Abbott [said Thursday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFu6zAMRb9G3hTItGLFg4a3eMtbOxq0REdCFTmVmDj5-8IB2h_oSIK8OPd8nKczxhTz5T9eyfJzWadMW03ETGW6YQ6YfSLCwuHrjp803x1RnUBBL5WRoCePMb0m3Xg7Kz-0DdnWnPRpUIMemmCdMgB9p3TXa0RzdH6BFsF1rl-gM9BEu4cpA7ptFYA5qFYZ3R_9TP1xRjwJrchHXsuBAzE9sS7ptT6oHNx6bZINzLcqun8CRgFjxYz5QmlN8UH7hYBxryRgfP8KGH_hu5-l9MgoHWWmIrfIwRfcqsRlnxdMuyFZw1pYVsbssfjaFOtvW0wp1t4IrS5XjOmNxH8T-bDwHQAA__-Vyohm). The governor said he'll seek legislation to codify the standards, require large data centers to report annual electricity and water usage, and repeal sales tax exemptions for the industry.
## Panhandle Quake Strongest Since 1900
A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck the Texas Panhandle at 5:21 a.m. Thursday. It was the [strongest recorded in the region](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2S4yAQBeDToAwXQkhIAcEmyrzphqoG2hLlRngB-ef2U3Ywc4DJu_q97_07L2cIFPb1L0Q09XlJy46PQlgr5uUG-wa7J0TIdft_wBXt4RDLIoUcuNBcqsVDoNeiGm-s8FPboGn1qMZJTGpqNiN66bvRoZOjQGudbzvV9aqzrZuE1roJ5v1MaKnaVkipT6IVWg29tzj0FmBkSqAPNeVT3bDiE8qFXumO-eRSbMhstd4K6_4wOTM5g3UaIuRAlN4HTM5vEZMzJQfE5Bxh3UM9PPKe_8B42eCKhX8C-Lec7wiZxwAx8KPwFROlNTggXo58xxc_ylqabPztEYhCGTRTYo0Q6NOu_m7Tu5FfAQAA___-dI6B) since at least 1900, according to U.S. Geological Survey records. The quake hit about [24 miles northwest of Miami](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvgzAUhH8NbEHGcWwzeOiSLV07Ws_2A9w4mOIHIf--okvVuePdSfed7uNmbxBTnIZ3eKChvc92wmdJSISLnWEaYQoJERYav1a4o1s9YrGccXli6sSFDRDTy4o6GMdC19ZoWqWF7lgnuno00F4QpXM-qC7oIDWchey11KwPHpWvoznKmOKibRnnqmEtU0JegkN5cQC6EgxDpLw0NCLhDqVPr7zh0vj8qJMZieZSnd8qfq349Xdqs5ahNEPe_rjlUBtONMOAFb_SfuDzZ4L764h29CvFDevFhPkZU4pFqkqw4QEx_RDpfz9thn8HAAD__88IftI) in Roberts County at a shallow depth of 3.5 miles. Shaking was reported from Amarillo and Lubbock to Oklahoma City, Tulsa, and the northern Dallas suburbs. "_Woke us up in Mobeetie. Lasted about 20 seconds or so. A picture fell off a shelf also_ ," Kellie Bryce May [posted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSsyAUhZ8GOx24IsSC4m_s8rdbOle5icwiuECiefsdU-w-wPbfOWe-83Edr-i8C_f_uJIpxy2OgfbsqRRK44ZhwWA9EaayfD3wk6bHTJRH4KBqrmuQo0XnX6OsrJm47UVFRuiLvPS8l321mFm0XaeU1RN2uqe5RWyt5SeLIEVXOXOWcQ1SCA6gGy64lqqzE6luQrwwycm6ElNTFip0YL75V3xSaua4Vt4spWyZtf8YDAyGfd-bWzxALfGRSwwnxGA4rRgM73j9q1P_KNZ5I0wrhioZu-3Oe5eVZpLfV3T-PVX-dtDTwHcAAAD__-VjfD0) on the National Weather Service Amarillo's Facebook page. No injuries or significant damage were reported, and DPS and TxDOT found [no damage to area roadways](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGyozAQRE8jMqjRWCAIFGxC5k03pEZobKlWCBYJY99-i5_8A_ysg65-9frPfbpTiCE9f9PCprwf65T4zJFL4X3aKHlKLjLTXvy_g_6yPWbmPCFgV4OuUU2OQvxMqnLGghtkxUbqXvUDDGqovLFoHz2jmlUn5wFbe8O-0y1pohaUm6tgrjHQqKQERN2ABK261lnuWkvUCwXsQln3pngu_Kb8iJ_1xXszr0sVjS9ly-L2S-AocDzPs7kUZk8pcZRwtQSOF0TgCPrKN4HjQs8UyuG4bqH-FqzzehTPlEudN6Z9oSRwrHbjtjPEGHKnhYLnQiF-8cvPXnsZ_B8AAP__Y4KAVg). It was only the fourth quake of magnitude 4.0 or greater recorded in the Panhandle since 1900, and scientists haven't yet determined a cause.
## 18-Wheeler Left Dangling over Katy Freeway
A Thursday morning crash left an 18-wheeler [dangling over the edge](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO5CAQBdDT2BktwDQ0AcEmzmbTDa3ClBs0NHihejy-_cp7hUmrpKf__5-P5QNSTuX5G17o6HurS8GjZyTCtuxQIpSQEaFR_PuGT_TvFbEvkkvNuGFSLQFSPhc1Bud5sGJEJ8xDPSy3yo7R-UlwPeF9VZJjWK0MloPRiCZ4P2kzJndh3EglBJfS3LjgRul78KjvHuAxKI4hUW03ikj4DX3LZ_3Cdlvra8wuEu19mH4Nch7kDH4V0_UZ5LzXToOcxYMdETFjYx2xsADleXVmddvYJ9DJtoZ4wMkudYfeWUzPeB2sZakQto4rpVrYgZ1YhNZSZ2t9Fzov3971JLUa5Dw2F_Yj5Zy6NoPizxek_D8n_WzdLyf_BQAA___NwI_V) of the Katy Freeway at Highway 99 in west Harris County.
